text:
1. 16. 4. 13. 

Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ. Atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ. Evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhanti samādhiṃ,146 labhanti cittassa ekaggaṃ. Atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā na labhanti samādhiṃ, na labhanti cittassa ekaggaṃ.148
